countdown.days: This discussion locks in {count} days if nobody replies.
countdown.day: This discussion locks tomorrow if nobody replies.
countdown.today: This discussion locks today if nobody replies.
countdown.title: Quiet discussions are locked automatically after {days} days.

post.locked: Locked automatically after {count} days without a reply.

settings.title: Auto Lock
settings.description: Locks discussions that have gone quiet, so old threads stop collecting replies nobody is waiting for.
settings.enabled_help: Off until you turn it on. Nothing is locked while this is off.
settings.days_help: Counted from the most recent post. Minimum 1.
settings.exempt_tags_help: Discussions with any of these tags stay open no matter how quiet they get.
settings.show_countdown_label: Show a countdown above the reply box
settings.show_countdown_help: Tells members a discussion is about to lock while they can still reply to it.
settings.post_notice_label: Leave a note in the discussion when it locks
settings.post_notice_help: Adds one line to the discussion saying it was locked automatically, and after how long. Without it a thread just closes with no explanation.
settings.scheduler_notice: This runs on Flarum's scheduler, so it only works if your server runs the schedule:run command every minute. To see what would happen without changing anything, run the auto-lock command with --dry-run.
